title: Carnivore-Leaning Board
seo_title: Carnivore Charcuterie Board: Meat, Cheese, Eggs & Shopping List
description: A carnivore-leaning charcuterie board for 6: aged cheddar, Gruyère, Parmesan, prosciutto, salami, bresaola, bacon, pork rinds and hard-boiled eggs. About 4 g net carbs.
hook: Animal-based, almost no plants: meat, cheese, eggs and pork rinds, with flaky salt.
why: This board is for people eating carnivore-style or close to it. Aged cheddar, Gruyère and Parmesan chunks give three textures, and prosciutto, salami, bresaola and bacon give four very different meats.

Pork rinds handle the crunch and hard-boiled eggs make it a meal. Flaky salt on the eggs is the only seasoning it needs. At about 81 g of protein a serving, it's the highest-protein board in the book.

timeline.what: Take out the three cheeses. Bake the bacon (400°F, about 18 min).

faq.q: What goes on a carnivore charcuterie board?
faq.a: Cured meats, bacon, aged cheeses, hard-boiled eggs, pork rinds and salt.
Many people eating carnivore-style include aged cheese because it's low in carbs. Strict versions leave it out.
About 4 g net carbs per serving for 6.
